Alpha Vantage API Documentation

Time Series Data

This category provides access to real-time and historical time series data for stocks, ETFs, and digital currencies. All data is delivered in JSON format and includes intraday, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.

TIME_SERIES_DAILY

This API returns daily time series data.

Python Example

import requests

url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=TIME_SERIES_DAILY&symbol=IBM&apikey=demo'
r = requests.get(url)
data = r.json()

print(data)

GLOBAL_QUOTE

This API returns real-time quote data.

Python Example

import requests

# This is a slightly different version with comments
url = 'https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=GLOBAL_QUOTE&symbol=AAPL&apikey=demo'
response = requests.get(url)  # Make the request
quote_data = response.json()  # Parse JSON

print(quote_data)  # Display the result
